data.name: Fatinah
data.gender_notes: Fatinah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Fatinah represents a deliverer, an opener, and a conquering woman. The name is derived from the Arabic word ‘fatatanah’ which means ‘she has opened’ or ‘she has delivered’. Fatinah is a powerful name that evokes images of strength, courage, and victory. In the Quran, Fatinah is mentioned as the name of a group of women who were companions of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).
